title: Personal Post Feed
text:
## Personal Post Feed
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000076680
Users will have a dedicated “feed” page accessible within their account dashboard. This personalized feed will list all recent posts published by other members who they have marked as a favorite.
Important: Personal Post Feed requires the Bookmark My Favorites add-on to be enabled as well. This will allows users to mark members on the website as a favorite. In order for the Personal Post Feed to appear the member needs to bookmark a another member and then the Personal Post Feed link is going to appear on their main dashboard.
Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Personal Post Feed Add-On

## Enabling this Add-On
1. Go to Finance - Membership Plans:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092137820/original/tUr5FqYhJdKuxVkLbDNh0xfmlbMeVrJG8g.png?1620084333 | alt: ]
2. Select the membership level(s) that the admin wish to grant this add-on to:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092137853/original/lKHjD4jewxtkfr2Bod9PRu--l9Eosil2HQ.png?1620084415 | alt: ]
3. Once in the membership level settings, go to Member's Dashboard tab and scroll down:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092137912/original/g939li_viWsqliiNgCiWiYGbkaeD5Ubolg.png?1620084566 | alt: ]
4. Once the Additional Settings section appears please enable the Personal Post Feed in the setting below:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092137950/original/Pk8gFn4tSKSj6NMyApzqzIi0gveGI5syOQ.png?1620084706 | alt: ]
This will enable this setting for the members in their dashboard:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092138078/original/qThj_1rUU9rhcyc_h0MrEyGn9BBupu-Nng.png?1620085011 | alt: ]
If the member click on it, it will redirect them to a new page where they'll be able to see all their saved post:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092138131/original/HKRL0LCuVo1C2BQyEwVTK7-6-8cN_l5VPg.png?1620085138 | alt: ]
The admin will have the option to edit this page within the SEO Templates by going to Content - SEO Template:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092138254/original/7Y00zeKtcjVDN-AlCVkAhfCj8GBEQqnLjQ.png?1620085456 | alt: ]
The admin will be able to edit the URL from here:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12092171408/original/hAy69AKC0S_GeYfyFS1d07XJtN57UKwu2w.png?1620138073 | alt: ]
Once the add-on is activated the admin will be able to add the Personal Post Feed widget within the member's dashboard. The name of the widget is Bootstrap Theme - Personal Post Feed - Results .
